chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Qasim ibn 'Urwah, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:

I asked Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about the time of zuhr and 'asr. He said: When the sun declines, the time for zuhr and 'asr both enters together, except that this one is before that one. Then you remain within the time of both of them together until the sun sets.

key_terms.الشَّمْسُ: the sun, whose movement determines the prayer time
key_terms.تَغِيبَ: to set or disappear below the horizon
key_terms.جَمِيعًا: together, jointly within one shared time span
key_terms.وَقْتِ: appointed legal time for an act of worship

ai.seo_question: When do the times of zuhr and 'asr begin and end according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the legal time of the zuhr and 'asr prayers. It states that both times begin with the sun's decline, while zuhr has precedence over 'asr, and that the shared time continues until sunset.
